adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts and parses `reqBody.keys` via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no `try/catch` or validation. If the env key is missing/empty (note the `|| ""`), the ciphertext is invalid, decryption fails, or plaintext is not valid JSON, this will throw and Next.js will surface it as a 500. The route otherwise returns explicit 4xx for auth/user/app errors, so this is an unhandled error path introduced by the diff.
